summary: Iteration 36: Polls, @Mentions, and Story Poll Integration - All backend APIs verified working. Frontend UI elements verified via screenshots. 18/18 backend tests passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Poll endpoints (POST /api/social/polls, POST /api/social/polls/{id}/vote, GET /api/social/polls/{id}) all working correctly
Story creation with poll_id (POST /api/stories/) working - stories feed returns poll_id in story data
Post and comment creation with @mentions working - triggers notification to mentioned users
NotificationContext.js correctly reads VAPID key from process.env.REACT_APP_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
VAPID keys match between frontend (.env) and backend (.env)
PostCard.jsx has RenderContent component that parses @username and #hashtag into clickable links
CreatePost.jsx has @mention autocomplete dropdown with data-testid='mention-autocomplete'
Stories.jsx has CreateStoryModal with Foto/Video and Encuesta (Poll) tabs
StoryViewer displays poll via StoryPoll component when story has poll_id
Animated reactions popup uses framer-motion AnimatePresence with data-testid='reactions-popup'
Bookmark toggle has motion animation via framer-motion

success_rate.frontend: 90% (UI elements verified via screenshots, browser automation had intermittent crashes)

seed_data_creation: Test polls and stories created during testing (prefixed with TEST_)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 36 verified polls, @mentions, and story poll integration. Key findings: 1) Poll CRUD APIs at /api/social/polls work correctly. 2) Story creation with poll_id at POST /api/stories/ (trailing slash required). 3) @mention search at GET /api/users/mention-search?q=. 4) VAPID keys configured in both frontend and backend .env files. 5) Frontend components: PostCard.jsx (RenderContent for @mentions/#hashtags, reactions popup), CreatePost.jsx (@mention autocomplete), Stories.jsx (CreateStoryModal with poll mode, StoryPoll component). Key data-testids: post-card-{id}, post-like-btn, post-bookmark-btn, reactions-popup, reaction-{type}, mention-autocomplete, mention-option-{username}, create-story-modal, story-mode-media, story-mode-poll, poll-question-input, poll-option-input-{idx}, story-publish-btn.

poll_create_api.details: Creates poll with question, options, duration_hours. Returns poll with id, options with votes=0

poll_vote_api.details: Records vote, prevents double voting (returns 400), validates option_index

poll_get_api.details: Returns poll data with vote counts, returns 404 for nonexistent poll

story_with_poll_api.details: Creates story with poll_id attached, poll_id appears in stories feed

mention_search_api.details: Returns matching users with id, username, display_name, avatar_url

post_with_mentions.details: Creates post with @mentions in content, triggers notification to mentioned users

react_to_post_api.details: Records reaction (like, love, fire, laugh, wow, sad)

vapid_key_config.details: NotificationContext.js reads REACT_APP_VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY from env, keys match between frontend and backend

frontend_post_cards.details: PostCard shows like, comment, repost, share, bookmark buttons with data-testids

frontend_hashtag_links.details: Hashtags in posts are clickable links to /hashtag/{tag}

frontend_mention_links.details: RenderContent parses @username into clickable links to /profile/{username}

frontend_reactions_popup.details: PostCard.jsx has AnimatePresence reactions popup with framer-motion animations

frontend_story_poll_mode.details: CreateStoryModal has Foto/Video and Encuesta tabs, creates poll then story with poll_id
